formula_definitions.description: Frequency/polysemy/case-shape control using normalized additive weights.
Cosine-style feature-vector agreement between observed cell features and a hand-specified risk direction.
Additive baseline plus rank-by-polysemy and failure-class interactions.
Noisy-or composition where multiple moderate risks can compound.
Risk is dominated by the strongest individual warning signal.
Uses separate positive-active, shadow-negative, and phrase/no-winner formulas.
Sigmoid transform over normalized feature evidence.
Small monotone rule table that prioritizes phrase/near-tie/coverage cells without fitting thresholds to outcomes.
Robust median-rank aggregation over the non-control formula shapes.
Deterministic random score from cell_id hash. It should not be trusted even if the small draft lane happens to rank well.
Target-lemma length only. Useful for exposing accidental lexical leakage.
Rank feature only, with missing rank preserved as an explicit missingness indicator.
Validation-only control that rotates observed difficulties inside each comparison scope.

methodology.data_help_priority_formula: exposure_weight * product_impact_weight * uncertainty_weight * predicted_failure_risk * fixability_weight * coverage_gap_weight

internal_split.interpretation: Advisory only. This is not a substitute for future locked heldout data.

methodology.objective: Rank source/case/scorer cells by observed difficulty and expected manual_or_llm_data_help_priority.

next_steps: Inspect top data-help cells before generating more LLM rows.
Promote no runtime behavior from this report alone.
Use the top phrase/no-winner and underfilled cells as the next manual/LLM expansion queue.
After expansion, rerun this report and compare discovery-versus-locked stability.
